name: Wardoll
detailed_description:
Bring back nostalgia with this commander vs commander wargame. You will experience battles of toy soldiers with rifles, tanks and rockets that will help you reimagine how playing with dolls is.

Each team has 1 commander and all the game revolves around it. You need to make sure to keep yours alive while trying to defeat the enemy one. If the commander die the game is lost, if you kill the enemy commander the game is won. The enemy commander is the one standing on their base and yours is the US Army Cavalry Scout 19-D Wardoll.

  • You will send riflemans or tanks to the enemy commander?

  • 50, 100 or 200 soldiers is enough to controll the battlefield?

  • Long battle with toy soldiers or short operation to kill enemy commander?

Is time for you to experience what it feels to play with a doll in a way that you have never seen before!

Rifleman - They cost 60 gas and 20 earth, is the backbone of your toy army. You can spawn units pressing the picture of it on the bottom left corner. You need a 3D Printer in order to build the and they apear where you build the printer. Select them with left click and order the position right clicking the terrain.

Tank - They cost 100 gas and 100 earth. You can spawn units pressing the picture of it on the bottom left corner. You need a 3D Printer in order to build the and they apear where you build the printer. Select them with left click and order the position right clicking the terrain.

Anti Tank - They cost 100 gas and 100 earth. You can spawn units pressing the picture of it on the bottom left corner. You need a 3D Printer in order to build the and they apear where you build the printer. Select them with left click and order the position right clicking the terrain.

Resources:

Earth - You start with full resouces and make more all the time. If need to get resources faster just need to build more excavators.

Gas - You start with full resouces and make more all the time. If need to get resources faster just need to build more pumpjacks.

short_description: Wardoll is wargame campaign that you play as a doll on a commander vs commander game mode. Build, spawn toy soldiers and send them to battle! In a top down perspective you can experience a backyard battle with riflemans, tanks and AT but also your doll has a special gun that you can use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: NO
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system
